comment: The three sentences of the 'Coastlines' video inside the demo. 'src' is the original narration (Japanese; Korean for Japanese viewers), 'dub' the viewer's language. Spoken by Gemini 3.8 Live and shown in the subtitle card / player captions.
style: a warm, calm travel-documentary narrator; unhurried, intimate and clear, like the voice-over of a beautiful coastal road film; natural pace, no long pauses

ja.name: 日本語
ja.L1: 新しい道には、新しい物語がある。
ja.L2: この道は、海までずっと続いている。
ja.L3: 耳を澄ませて。ここまで波の音が聞こえる。

en.L1: Every new path tells a new story.
en.L2: This road runs all the way to the sea.
en.L3: Listen — you can hear the waves from here.
